info.title: Device scan login HTTP contract
info.description: Independent 18-operation scan contract. Browser (8) and device (10) routers are mounted separately with host-selected prefixes. Scan modes are configured per entry; UI assets are not part of this JSON API contract.

post.description: Records approval; this does not activate the target session. POST JSON; body limit 16384 bytes; strict DTO rejects unknown members and duplicate JSON keys. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Browser guard requires configured exact Origin and x-embedded-idp-browser: 1, rejects tenant header, and accepts Sec-Fetch-Site only when absent or exactly same-origin. Cookie name/origin are host-profile values; expected_session is checked against the authenticated browser identity.

post.description: Aborts a pending delivery. HTTP 409 already_acknowledged means acknowledgement won the race and the target session is already active; preserve the bundle/session and recover or query status. Abort is not logout. POST JSON; body limit 16384 bytes; strict DTO rejects unknown members and duplicate JSON keys. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Proof profile is EMBEDDED-IDP-DEVICE-SCAN-V2. The signed bytes bind the proof fields (challenge, device id, key id, signed-at) to exact raw body bytes, POST method, externally prefixed path, tenant and configured audience, then append scan-context-sha256 as unpadded base64url. This is SHA-256 of the domain separator EMBEDDED-IDP-SCAN-CONTEXT-V1 plus length-prefixed canonical purpose_str, trusted target_client_id and entry_id. These trusted route-context values are not taken from request headers or body. Duplicate proof headers, query parameters and changed body are rejected. TrustedScanHostContext must also be injected by the host.

parameters.name: x-device-id
parameters.description: Device identifier; non-empty visible ASCII, at most 128 bytes.

parameters.name: x-device-key-id
parameters.description: Registered 32-byte Ed25519 key thumbprint, unpadded base64url.

parameters.name: x-device-challenge
parameters.description: 32-byte proof challenge, unpadded base64url.

parameters.name: x-device-signature
parameters.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature, unpadded base64url.

parameters.name: x-device-signed-at
parameters.description: Canonical unsigned Unix seconds; no sign or leading zero except 0.
